mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM runtime_turn WHERE id = #{turnId} AND lease_version = #{leaseVersion} AND status = 'RUNNING' FOR SHARE
UPDATE runtime_thread SET last_item_seq = last_item_seq + 1, update_at = now() WHERE id = #{threadId} RETURNING last_item_seq

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY seq

SELECT thread_id AS threadId, seq, id, turn_id AS turnId, step, type, role, content_json AS contentJson, token_count AS tokenCount, discarded, data_label AS dataLabel, create_at AS createAt FROM runtime_item WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND seq > #{afterSeq} ORDER BY seq LIMIT #{limit}
